name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
shortDescription: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into farmers' bank accounts.
benefits: ₹6,000/year direct cash transfer in 3 installments (every 4 months)
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names
Valid Aadhaar card linked with bank account
Active bank account with DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) enabled
Land record (Khata/Khasra) in applicant's name
ineligibility: Farmers holding constitutional posts or retired government employees with pension > ₹10,000/month
Income tax payers in last assessment year
applicationProcess: Step 1: Fill out the online application with Aadhaar and mobile number verification.
Step 2: Enter land details including State, District, Sub-District, Block, and Village with Survey/Khasra numbers.
Step 3: Upload Aadhaar, Land Record, and Bank Passbook copies.
Step 4: Physical verification by State Revenue / Agriculture nodal officer.
Step 5: Direct credit to bank account upon approval via PFMS.
importantInfo: eKYC is mandatory for all registered farmers via OTP or Biometric authentication. Installments are credited directly on the 1st week of April, August, and December.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
shortDescription: Comprehensive crop insurance covering non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages.
benefits: Financial support for crop failure due to drought, flood, pests, or unseasonal weather. Maximum premium rate: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for Commercial/Horticultural crops.
benefitAmount: Up to 100% sum insured payout based on yield loss assessment
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee (KCC holders) and non-loanee farmers are eligible
Must have sown the crop or intended to sow within the notified cutoff date
ineligibility: Losses due to war, nuclear risks, malicious damage, or preventable farmer negligence
requiredDocuments: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) / Land Revenue Receipt
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Agriculture Worker
applicationProcess: Step 1: Select season (Kharif / Rabi), State, District, and Crop.
Step 2: Calculate premium using the automated premium calculator.
Step 3: Upload Land Record and Sowing Certificate.
Step 4: Pay farmer's subsidized premium share (1.5% - 2%) online or via CSC.
Step 5: Insurance policy generated with unique Policy Number for claim tracking.
importantInfo: Report localized crop damage (cyclone, hailstorm, inundation) within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance App or Kisan Call Center (1800-180-1551).

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
shortDescription: Timely short-term credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and farm asset maintenance at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Loan limit up to ₹3,00,000 at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive). Collateral-free loan up to ₹1,60,000.
eligibility: Individual farmers / joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
Farmers involved in Animal Husbandry and Fisheries
ineligibility: Defaulters of prior institutional loans without restructuring
requiredDocuments: Identity & Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Land Record Documents certified by revenue authority
Cropping pattern details for current agricultural year
applicationProcess: Step 1: Submit single-page KCC application form online or at any commercial / cooperative bank branch.
Step 2: Bank verifies land records and calculates scale of finance based on cropping area.
Step 3: Sanction within 14 days without processing charges for loans up to ₹3 Lakhs.
Step 4: Receive RuPay Kisan Card for ATM and PoS transactions.
importantInfo: KCC credit comes with automatic personal accident insurance cover of ₹50,000 for death/permanent disability and ₹25,000 for other risks.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
shortDescription: Financial subsidy up to 50% for purchasing modern farm machinery, tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and harvesters.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy (up to ₹1.25 Lakhs - ₹5.00 Lakhs depending on equipment) on approved farm machinery and implements.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, women, and North-Eastern state farmers receive priority & higher subsidy (50%)
Individual farmers who have not availed machinery subsidy in the last 5 years
Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
ineligibility: Applicants who have already claimed equipment subsidy under SMAM/RKVY within past 5 years for same machine type
requiredDocuments: Quotation / Proforma Invoice from authorized machinery dealer
Caste Certificate (if applicable for enhanced subsidy)
applicationProcess: Step 1: Register on the SMAM portal / DBT Agriculture portal with Aadhaar.
Step 2: Select desired machine model and approved manufacturer/dealer.
Step 3: Upload proforma invoice and land documents.
Step 4: Department issue permit / sanction order.
Step 5: Purchase machinery and submit serial number & GPS geo-tagged photo for DBT subsidy release.
importantInfo: Direct verification through portal with real-time tracking of subsidy release directly to the farmer's linked bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
shortDescription: Promoting micro-irrigation technologies such as Drip and Sprinkler systems to enhance water use efficiency and farm productivity.
benefits: 55% subsidy for Small and Marginal farmers; 45% subsidy for other farmers on installation costs of Drip and Sprinkler irrigation units.
benefitAmount: Up to 55% subsidy on Micro-Irrigation setups
eligibility: All farmers owning cultivable land with an assured water source (tube well, borewell, canal, farm pond)
Members of Water User Associations (WUAs) and cooperative farming societies
Minimum cultivable plot size of 0.2 hectare
ineligibility: Fields without any primary water source for running micro-irrigation systems
requiredDocuments: Proof of Water Source and Electricity connection / Solar pump
applicationProcess: Step 1: Apply online with land details and water source verification.
Step 2: Field survey by the District Agriculture/Horticulture Officer and empanelled micro-irrigation company.
Step 3: Technical design estimate and work order generation.
Step 4: Installation of drip/sprinkler system with physical inspection.
Step 5: Direct subsidy transfer to beneficiary account or vendor adjustment as per state policy.
importantInfo: Micro-irrigation saves up to 40% water, increases fertilizer efficiency by 30%, and boosts crop productivity by up to 25%.
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
shortDescription: Promoting cluster-based organic farming with PGS certification, bio-fertilizers, and direct farmer-consumer marketing support.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is given directly for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides).
eligibility: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 or more farmers covering minimum 20 hectares / 50 acres
Individual farmers adopting PGS-India organic certification standards
No chemical fertilizer or synthetic pesticide usage on enrolled land
ineligibility: Farmers already claiming chemical fertilizer support for the enrolled parcel
applicationProcess: Step 1: Form a local cluster of 20+ farmers and register on Jaivik Kheti portal.
Step 2: Soil sampling and baseline organic conversion documentation.
Step 3: Receive 1st installment for bio-inputs and composting units.
Step 4: Periodic PGS peer reviews and organic certification issuance.
Step 5: Marketing linkages on the national organic agricultural portal.
importantInfo: Products receive official PGS-India Green and PGS-India Organic labels, fetching premium prices in retail markets.

name: National Mission on High Yielding Certified Seeds (Sub-Mission on Seeds)
shortDescription: Subsidized distribution of certified high-yielding, climate-resilient, and bio-fortified crop seeds to smallholder farmers.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on foundation and certified seeds of Cereals, Pulses, Oilseeds, and Millets distributed through state seed corporations.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding less than 2 hectares of cultivable land
Farmers residing in notified seed village programme districts
Must have active crop sowing registration in state portal
ineligibility: Commercial private seed multiplier firms applying as individual farmers
requiredDocuments: Seed requirement indent from Block Agriculture Office
applicationProcess: Step 1: Register crop sowing plan on state seed portal.
Step 2: Select crop variety and seed quantity (max 2 bags per farmer).
Step 3: Receive seed allocation coupon with unique QR code.
Step 4: Collect certified seed bags from nearest Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS) or Block Seed Store at subsidized price.
importantInfo: Certified seeds undergo rigorous germination tests (minimum 85% germination rate guaranteed) and are pre-treated with bio-fungicides.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
shortDescription: Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum period of 7 years, along with Credit Guarantee Fund Trust (CGTMSE) coverage.
benefitAmount: 3% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹2 Crore
eligibility: Farmers, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperative Societies
Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Self Help Groups (SHGs), Joint Liability Groups (JLGs)
Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups, and Central/State agency sponsored PPP projects
ineligibility: Projects without viable DPR (Detailed Project Report) or unrelated to post-harvest infrastructure
requiredDocuments: Detailed Project Report (DPR) of warehouse / cold storage / sorting unit
applicationProcess: Step 1: Register on the AIF Portal and submit DPR and basic project details.
Step 2: Ministry verifies project eligibility within 7 business days.
Step 3: Application routed to preferred scheduled commercial bank for credit appraisal.
Step 4: Loan sanctioned and 3% interest subvention auto-credited directly to loan account.
importantInfo: Covers warehouses, silos, cold storage, ripening chambers, sorting & grading units, pack houses, and assaying labs.

name: PM KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps Scheme)
shortDescription: Financial assistance for standalone solar agriculture pumps and solarization of existing grid-connected agriculture pumps.
benefits: 60% subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Govt) on total solar pump system cost. Farmer contributes only 10%; remaining 30% available via bank loan.
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, Water User Associations, and FPOs
Cultivable land with existing borewell / open well requiring irrigation
Preference to un-electrified diesel pump owners
ineligibility: Lands with severe water table depletion where new borewells are prohibited without permission
requiredDocuments: Recent Electricity Bill (for Component C grid-connected solarization)
applicationProcess: Step 1: Apply online on State Renewable Energy Agency portal under PM-KUSUM.
Step 2: Choose pump capacity (3 HP, 5 HP, 7.5 HP or 10 HP AC/DC pump).
Step 3: Deposit 10% farmer share upon technical site feasibility confirmation.
Step 4: Vendor installs solar panels, structure, and pump with 5-year comprehensive warranty.
Step 5: Inspection and commissioning certificate issuance.
importantInfo: Eliminates diesel costs completely and provides daytime reliable electricity for irrigation, plus option to sell surplus power back to the grid.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
shortDescription: Flagship scheme for focused and sustainable development of fisheries sector, pond construction, and biofloc aquaculture.
benefits: 40% subsidy of total unit cost for General category; 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women beneficiaries for aquaculture units, fish feed mills, and refrigerated vans.
eligibility: Fishers, Fish farmers, Fish workers, Fish vendors
Individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, JLGs, and Fisheries Cooperatives
Owned or leased land / water bodies with minimum 7-year lease agreement
ineligibility: Non-compliant units under coastal regulation zone guidelines
requiredDocuments: Land / Waterbody Ownership or Lease Document
applicationProcess: Step 1: Submit self-contained project proposal on PMMSY portal.
Step 2: District Level Committee (DLC) scrutinizes proposal and approves unit.
Step 3: State Fisheries Department issues administrative sanction.
Step 4: Phase-wise release of subsidy corresponding to construction milestones.
importantInfo: Supports freshwater aquaculture, Biofloc, RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture Systems), ornamental fish breeding, and cold chain vehicles.
ministry: Department of Fisheries / Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
